1: // Space Drift – minimal HTML‑canvas game
2: // Canvas must exist with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // audio context for sound effects
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   const playTone = (freq, dur) => {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
21:   };
22: 
23:   // ---- game state -------------------------------------------------
24:   const ship = { x: 80, y: H / 2, r: 15, speed: 4, shield: 0 };
25:   let asteroids = [];
26:   let fuels = [];
27:   let score = 0;
28:   let gameOver = false;
29:   // starfield background
30:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
31:     x: rand(0, W),
32:     y: rand(0, H),
33:     size: rand(1, 3)
34:   }));
35: 
36:   // ---- utility ----------------------------------------------------
37:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
38:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
39: 
40:   // ---- input ------------------------------------------------------
41:   const keys = {};
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
43:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
44: 
45:   // ---- spawn helpers ----------------------------------------------
46:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
47:     const size = rand(15, 40);
48:     asteroids.push({ x: W + size, y: rand(0, H), r: size, speed: rand(2, 5) });
49:   };
50:   const spawnFuel = () => {
51:     const r = 10;
52:     fuels.push({ x: W + r, y: rand(0, H), r, speed: 2.5, collected: false });
53:   };
54: 
55:   // ---- main loop -------------------------------------------------
56:   const update = () => {
57:     if (gameOver) return;
58:     // ship movement
59:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
60:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
61:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
62:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
63:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W, ship.x));
64:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H, ship.y));
65: 
66:     // spawn obstacles
67:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
68:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnFuel();
69: 
70:     // move asteroids
71:     asteroids.forEach(a => (a.x -= a.speed));
72:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.x + a.r > 0);
73: 
74:     // move fuels
75:     fuels.forEach(f => (f.x -= f.speed));
76:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.x + f.r > 0 && !f.collected);
77: 
78:     // shield timer
79:     if (ship.shield > 0) ship.shield -= 1;
80: 
81:     // collision detection
82:     for (const a of asteroids) {
83:       if (dist(ship, a) < ship.r + a.r) {
84:         if (ship.shield > 0) {
85:           // destroy asteroid, lose shield
86:           ship.shield = 0;
87:           asteroids = asteroids.filter(x => x !== a);
88:           // shield hit sound
89:           playTone(440, 0.08);
90:         } else {
91:           gameOver = true;
92:           // crash sound
93:           playTone(180, 0.3);
94:         }
95:         break;
96:       }
97:     }
98:     for (const f of fuels) {
99:       if (!f.collected && dist(ship, f) < ship.r + f.r) {
100:         f.collected = true;
101:         score += 10;
102:         ship.shield = 180; // ~3 seconds of shield
103:         // fuel collection sound
104:         playTone(660, 0.12);
105:       }
106:     }
107:   };
108: 
109:   const draw = () => {
110:     // background gradient
111:     const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
112:     bg.addColorStop(0, '#000014');
113:     bg.addColorStop(1, '#000030');
114:     ctx.fillStyle = bg;
115:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
116:     // stars
117:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
118:     for (const s of stars) {
119:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
120:       // slight twinkle
121:       s.x -= 0.5;
122:       if (s.x < 0) { s.x = W; s.y = rand(0, H); }
123:     }
124:     // ship
125:     ctx.save();
126:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
127:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield > 0 ? 'rgba(0,255,255,0.5)' : '#00ffcc';
128:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
129:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
130:     ctx.beginPath();
131:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.r);
132:     ctx.lineTo(ship.r, ship.r);
133:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r);
134:     ctx.closePath();
135:     ctx.fill();
136:     ctx.stroke();
137:     ctx.restore();
138:     // asteroids with shading
139:     for (const a of asteroids) {
140:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
141:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
142:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
143:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
144:       ctx.beginPath();
145:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:       ctx.fill();
147:     }
148:     // fuels
149:     ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
150:     for (const f of fuels) {
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:       ctx.fill();
154:     }
155:     // UI
156:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
157:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
158:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
159:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
160:     if (ship.shield > 0) {
161:       ctx.fillText('Shield', 10, 40);
162:     }
163:     if (gameOver) {
164:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
165:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
166:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
167:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
168:     }
169:   };
170: 
171:   const loop = () => {
172:     update();
173:     draw();
174:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   };
176: 
177:   // start
178:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
179: })();

(End of file - total 179 lines)
</content>
